title: glandora diffusa
intro: Glandora diffusa, commonly known as the sticky ball or sticky gilia, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Glandora diffusa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which can help in wound healing and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
